Thai Healing Massage Academy has trained 2,500+ massage therapists worldwide since 2001.

Learn Thai Massage online with:

✅ NCBTMB-approved CEUs 
✅ Personal instructor support from Shama Kern (20+ years experience)
✅ Techniques that protect YOUR body while delivering incredible results

Subscribe for weekly videos on:
- Body-saving massage techniques
- How to earn more as a massage therapist
- Thai massage tutorials and demonstrations

Founded by Shama Kern, who has lived in Thailand for 20 years and created high quality and detailed Thai Massage training courses.

Visit our website to learn more:  https://thaihealingmassage.com
